description:
The HACP/2.0 wire unit (§5.2).

`extra` carries every field this build does not know, so re-serialization preserves them — the forward-compatibility rule, mechanically enforced.

body.description: Kind-specific body; must be canonicalizable (integers only, §5.1).

from.description: Author: an agent URN, and a participant of the session (enforced by the session engine, not the shape).

in_reply_to.description: The message being answered, when this message is an answer.

kind.description: Registry string; unknown kinds are valid on receipt (§5.3).

session_id.description: The session this message belongs to (§6). On `session.open` it names the prospective session.

title: Envelope
